domain.description: Agency domain displayed in the identifier.

language.description: Language for labels and helper text.

parentAgencies.description: Array of parent agency links used in the disclaimer.

logos.description: Array of avatar-style logos. Each item supports: src, alt, href, shape ('circle'|'rounded-sm'|'rounded-md'|'rounded-lg'|'rounded-xl'), and imageClassName.

taxpayerDisclaimer.description: Appends the taxpayer disclaimer sentence to the identity disclaimer.

overlapAvatars.description: Apply overlap styling to avatar logos.

logoShape.description: Default shape applied to all logos. Per-logo shape field takes precedence.
